title: Whole-book artifact nomination and same-lineage eligibility
question: Does the full authentic Standard book supply score-eligible pairs for the same-lineage scorer?
method: Run the released artifact producer on all 29 exact views of Standard run 297. Count score dispositions over the completed book-wide report. Export the exact managed closure and independently verify its manifest digest.

outputs.role: Exact artifact inventory, nomination routes and score dispositions
Managed held result and verified detached manifest

conclusion: The whole-book Standard artifact report establishes zero score-eligible pairs. The 483 reference-only and 47 namespace-unavailable nominations retain their actual dispositions. The authentic same-lineage assessment trigger remains unsatisfied.
